categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and directly edits Guix build configurations (`contrib/guix/`) and depends packages (`depends/packages/boost.mk`).
categories.rationale: Reduces static non-GUI Linux binary sizes by ~0.48 MB by stripping unused `libstdc++` components in a minimal GCC toolchain variant. The PR description provides measurements demonstrating reductions across binaries (e.g. `bitcoind` from 17.75 MB to 17.27 MB, `bitcoin-cli` from 8.20 MB to 7.72 MB); while beneficial, binary size pruning is a deferrable optimization.
